first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates shorter onboarding improves completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. This is more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing, which previously harmed retention. Verify the strongest onboarding evidence and the closest alternative, activation messaging, before committing; measure downstream qualified activation and retention, not completion alone.

final.rationale: Run activation messaging because it directly addresses the 6% activation decline and the verified source shows gains in week-one engagement and activation with no observed retention harm. Shortened onboarding is not selected because it increased 60-day churn in complex-workspace accounts. Measure qualified activation, 30- and 60-day retention, and revenue quality because long-term revenue impact remains unverified.
